Extract a single PNG video frame at timestamp 0.5 seconds (t=0.5s) from clip.mp4 and save it to frame.png.
Query inventory.db (table items with columns sku, name, stock) for rows where stock < 10 ordered by sku ASC, and write the output as CSV with a header row to low_stock.csv.
